summary: Formula Systems filed a Form 6-K reporting its Q2 and first-half 2026 financial results via press release. The filing includes a capital raise by affiliate TSG through a private placement, diluting Formula's ownership from 37.33% to 32.87% and generating a $16.6 million capital gain. This is routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or activist activity is present. The filing is informational only.
